en: Guide
Win your way up the runway, and Elesa waits at the top. Ground moves hit her Electric types hard, but not her Emolga!
Surprised? This Gym is a fashion show and a battle all at once, on a runway lit up like a stage!
Here, a drink before the show!
The models on the catwalk will battle you one by one. Ground moves hit Electric types hard, but Emolga flies above them!
Your team outshone Elesa's lightning! That was a show the crowd won't forget.
Nikola
Welcome to the Nimbasa Gym! The show is about to begin, and you are walking in it!
My, what a debut! Go on, the runway is yours.
Fleming
Beauty on the outside is easy. Let's see how beautiful you are as a Trainer!
Beautiful and strong. That's a rare look!
Ampère
The show is nearly over. Let's see whether you deserve to share the stage with Elesa!
You do. The stage is waiting.
Elesa is more than a pretty face, you know. Don't let the lights fool you.
You and your Pokémon sparkled out there! Elesa's waiting on the stage.
Elesa
Welcome to the main stage. My Pokémon and yours are about to compete, and we'll see whose light shines brightest!
Well... You're even more dazzling than I thought. Your battling swept me off my feet. Here, this is yours!
{player} received the Bolt Badge from Elesa!
And a move I'm fond of. Use it if you like it as much as I do.
A model has to make other people's dreams come true without losing sight of herself. Trainers do the same for their Pokémon.
Keep shining, and the Pokémon League will see you coming a long way off!
The show starts at the foot of the runway. Walk it first, and I'll be waiting here.
My Pokémon and I want to shine together like two suns. I think you and yours already do.
